body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push the target 1 unit. Independently, your allies may pass through your space until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: After a hit, move into the target's vacated space.
An adjacent willing ally may move 2 units through the opened space after the attack.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or an ally crosses the target's former space before your next turn: that creature ignores movement Reactions from the target for that move.
